 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Harmony"** means a state of agreement or concord, creating a pleasing and consistent whole. (सामंजस्य)

 
 
• **Example:** The choir sang in perfect **harmony,** creating a beautiful and unified sound.
 
 
 
• **"Conflict"** refers to a serious disagreement or argument, typically a prolonged one, which disrupts peace and harmony. (संघर्ष)
 
 
• **Example:** The ongoing **conflict** between the two countries has caused much suffering and unrest.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'harmony'** is **'conflict'**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Adaptability** (अनुकूलता): The quality of being able to adjust to new conditions.

 
 
• **Example:** Her** adaptability** to different work environments makes her a valuable employee.
 
 
 
• **Clarity** (स्पष्टता): The quality of being coherent and intelligible.
 
 
• **Example:** The** clarity** of his speech made it easy for everyone to understand the complex topic.
 
 
 
• **Unity** (एकता): The state of being united or joined as a whole.
 
 
• **Example:** The** unity **among the team members was evident as they worked towards a common goal.
